scope: Isolated Chrome, own synthetic key/data, all outside traffic mocked; no real authenticated GET or TV

checks.name: Keyless Home immediately shows known films without requests/setup panel/fake feeds; Search CTA focuses the own keyboard
Personal recent/favorite cards and shared starter metadata deduplicate, keep both badges and support D-pad/detail/Back without a key
Key is trimmed and saved only in private key storage, used only as header, and never echoed/cached or written into the library
Unknown page count stays unknown; Next uses the real prior cursor and a failed next page restores the previous list/retry path
Genre modal traps D-pad/Tab and applies the actual genre plus section filters without catalog-index guesses
A last-good expired metadata record is shown with an explicit stale label when refresh fails
Rejected-key and rate-limit errors use static safe copy and do not expose response bodies or invent cards
Optional cache quota failure preserves key/library and in-memory cursor pagination still works
Key replacement aborts prior work, recreates the client and clears only catalog cursor/cache state
Large public metadata responses obey the600KiB LRU budget without evicting watched/favorites or the API key
Explicit key removal leaves personal collections intact, stops catalog requests and keeps the mobile layout inside the viewport
A malformed stored key containing CRLF is never passed to the client or sent anonymously
